Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.completedRie.type:
∀ (t : ℂ),
  (fun s => completedRiemannZeta (s + t)) = fun s => completedRiemannZeta₀ (s + t) - 1 / (s + t) - 1 / (1 - (s + t))

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.conj_gaussSu.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N),
  (starRingEnd ℂ) (gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar) = χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ZMod.stdAddChar

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.conj_stdAddC.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] (a : ZMod N), (starRingEnd ℂ) (ZMod.stdAddChar a) = ZMod.stdAddChar (-a)

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.gaussSum_mul.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N},
  χ.IsPrimitive → χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ZMod.stdAddChar = ↑N

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.isPrimitive_.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, ψ.IsPrimitive → ψ⁻¹.IsPrimitive

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.meromorphicA.type: ∀ (t x : ℂ), MeromorphicAt (fun s => completedRiemannZeta (s + t)) x

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.meromorphicO.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (t : ℂ),
  MeromorphicOn (fun s => DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction ψ (s + t)) Set.univ
∀ (t : ℂ), meromorphicOrderAt (fun s => completedRiemannZeta (s + t)) (1 - t) = -1

Langlands.HeckeRat.Analytic.norm_rootNum.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, ψ.IsPrimitive → ‖ψ.rootNumber‖ = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.H_congr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b b' : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b →
    ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ∣ b' - b → Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b' = Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b

Langlands.HeckeRat.H_inv.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (q : ℚ), Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ⁻¹ q = (Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ q)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.H_mul.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b c : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b →
    Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ c →
      Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑(b * c) = Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b * Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑c

Langlands.HeckeRat.H_neg_one.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t → ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ (-1)) = (-1) ^ n

Langlands.HeckeRat.H_zmod.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : ZMod (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)) {b : ℤ},
  ↑b = x → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑↑x.val = Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good.type:
(K : Type u_1) →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [inst_1 : NumberField K] →
      Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) →
        ℕ → NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K → Prop

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.exists_trivial_on.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K),
  ∃ S k,
    ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K),
      (↑x).1 = 1 →
        (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), Valued.v ((↑x).2 v) = 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ S, Valued.v ((↑x).2 v - 1) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k)) → χ ↑x = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.finite_nhds_one.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  {B : Set (IsDedekindDomain.FiniteAdeleRing (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K)},
  B ∈ nhds 1 →
    ∃ S k,
      ∀ (y : IsDedekindDomain.FiniteAdeleRing (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K),
        (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), Valued.v (y v) ≤ 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ S, Valued.v (y v - 1) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k)) → y ∈ B

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.good_inv.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) (k : ℕ)
  {x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k x → Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k x⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.good_mul.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) (k : ℕ)
  {x y : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k x → Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k y → Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k (x * y)

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.good_one.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) (k : ℕ),
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.good_pow.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) (k : ℕ)
  {x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k x → ∀ (n : ℕ), Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k (x ^ n)

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.idele_nhds_one.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  {U : Set (NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K)},
  U ∈ nhds 1 →
    ∃ S k, ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K), Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.Good K S k x → x ∈ U

Langlands.HeckeRat.Top.valued_nhds.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : Valued R (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))] {u : Set R} {x : R},
  u ∈ nhds x → ∃ k, ∀ (y : R), Valued.v (y - x) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k) → y ∈ u

Langlands.HeckeRat.absNorm_asIdeal.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal = Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v

Langlands.HeckeRat.absNorm_conductor.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), Ideal.absNorm χ.conductor = Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.algebraMap_intEquiv.type:
∀ (y : NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ),
  ↑((Rat.IsIntegralClosure.intEquiv (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) y) = (algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) y

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI.type: Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ → NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ →* ℂˣ

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_apply.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x = χ ↑x

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_decomp.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (q : ℚˣ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) (((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)⁻¹ * x) =
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_inv.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ⁻¹) x = ((Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_ofAdicCompletion.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (y : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)ˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ v) y) =
    (χ.finiteComponent v) y

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_ofCompletion.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (y : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ)
      ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ Rat.infinitePlace) y) =
    (χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) y

Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI_unitEmbedding.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (q : ℚˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.chi_eq_norm_cpow.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = 1 →
      ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ), ↑(χ ↑x) = ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ x) ^ t

Langlands.HeckeRat.coe_compFin.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ), ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x) = (↑x).2 v

Langlands.HeckeRat.coe_compFin_unitEmbed.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (q : ℚˣ),
  ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)) =
    (algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑q

Langlands.HeckeRat.coe_compInf_unitEmbed.type:
∀ (q : ℚˣ),
  ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)) =
    (algebraMap ℚ Rat.infinitePlace.Completion) ↑q

Langlands.HeckeRat.coe_loc.type:
∀ {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v}, x ≠ 0 → ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.loc v x) = x

Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin.type:
(v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) →
  NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ →* (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)ˣ

Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin_ofAdicComplet.type:
∀ {v w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ≠ v →
    ∀ (y : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ),
      (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ w) y) =
        1

∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (y : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)ˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ v) y) = y

Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin_ofCompletion.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (y : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v)
      ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ Rat.infinitePlace) y) =
    1

Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin_unitEmbedding.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (q : ℚˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q) =
    Langlands.HeckeRat.loc v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑q)

Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf_ofAdicComplet.type:
∀ (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (y : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ),
  Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ w) y) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf_ofCompletion.type:
∀ (y : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ),
  Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf
      ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.ofCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ Rat.infinitePlace) y) =
    y

Langlands.HeckeRat.completed_eq.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace (n Rat.infinitePlace) (t Rat.infinitePlace) →
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N) [inst : NeZero N] {s : ℂ},
      1 < (s + t Rat.infinitePlace).re →
        χ.completedLFunction n t s =
          DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ N hN) (s + t Rat.infinitePlace)

Langlands.HeckeRat.cond_inv.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  χ⁻¹.conductorExponent v = χ.conductorExponent v

Langlands.HeckeRat.cond_le_of_isTrivial.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)} {a : ℕ},
  χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v a → χ.conductorExponent v ≤ a

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_approx.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (u : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v),
  Valued.v u ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      ∃ b,
        Valued.v
            ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v))
                ((algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) b) -
              u) ≤
          WithZero.exp (-↑k)

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_approx_crt.type:
∀ (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)))
  (u :
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) →
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v),
  (∀ v ∈ S, Valued.v (u v) ≤ 1) →
    ∀ (k : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℕ),
      ∃ b,
        ∀ v ∈ S,
          Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b - u v) ≤
            WithZero.exp (-↑(k v))

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_good_H.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    ∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ),
      Valued.v ↑u = 1 →
        ∃ b,
          Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b ∧
            Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b = (χ.finiteComponent w) u ∧
              Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑b - ↑u) ≤
                  WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent w)) ∧
                ∀ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ,
                  v ≠ w →
                    Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b - 1) ≤
                      WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent v))

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_rat_val.type:
∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  ∃ q,
    ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑q) =
        Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_trivOn.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), ∃ m S, Langlands.HeckeRat.TrivOn χ m ∧ ∀ v ∉ S, m v = 0

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_unit_decomp.type:
∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  ∃ q,
    ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v
          ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v)
              (((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)⁻¹ * x)) =
        1

Langlands.HeckeRat.ext_idele.type:
∀ {x y : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x = Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf y →
    (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x = (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) y) →
      x = y

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_loc_c.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x y : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w},
  Valued.v x = 1 →
    Valued.v y = 1 →
      Valued.v (y - x) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent w)) →
        (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w y) = (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_local.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
      w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
        ↑((χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.localUniformizer ℚ w)) =
          (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) *
            ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ^ (-t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_pr_mu.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    (χ.finiteComponent w)
          (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w
            ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w))) *
        ((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace)
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf
              ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ)
                (Units.mk0 ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ⋯))) *
          Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)) =
      1

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_unifo.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.localUniformizer ℚ w) =
      (χ.finiteComponent w)
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w
          ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)))

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteLFunction_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ {s : ℂ},
      1 < (s + t).re →
        χ.finiteLFunction s = LSeries (fun k => (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑k) (s + t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.gammaFactor_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace (n Rat.infinitePlace) (t Rat.infinitePlace) →
    ∀ (s : ℂ),
      Langlands.gammaFactor ℚ n t s =
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯).gammaFactor (s + t Rat.infinitePlace)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_congr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b b' : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ∣ b' - b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b'

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_iff_coprime.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (n : ℕ), Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑n ↔ n.Coprime (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_mul.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b c : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ c → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ (b * c)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_pr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_zmod_val.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : ZMod (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)) {b : ℤ},
  ↑b = x → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑x.val

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_decomp.type:
∀ (q : ℚˣ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ (((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)⁻¹ * x) =
    Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ x

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_mul.type:
∀ (a b : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ (a * b) = Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ a * Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ b

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_of_units.type:
∀ (y : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) y) = 1) →
    Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ y = ‖↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf y)‖

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_unitEmbeddi.type: ∀ (q : ℚˣ), Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.infiniteComponent_of_.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ),
      (NumberField.InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding Rat.infinitePlace) ↑z = ↑(Real.exp a) →
        ↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) z) = Complex.exp (↑a * t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.infiniteComponent_rat.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (q : ℚˣ),
      ↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace)
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q))) =
        (↑↑q / ↑|↑↑q|) ^ n * ↑|↑↑q| ^ t

Langlands.HeckeRat.intCast_mem_asIdeal_p.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
  ↑z ∈ v.asIdeal ^ k ↔ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ k ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.isCoprime_of_good.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ}, Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → IsCoprime b ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)

Langlands.HeckeRat.isTrivial_cond.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v (χ.conductorExponent v)

Langlands.HeckeRat.isTrivial_mono.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)} {a b : ℕ},
  a ≤ b → χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v a → χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v b

Langlands.HeckeRat.isUnit_of_good.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ}, Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → IsUnit ↑b

Langlands.HeckeRat.isUnramifiedAt_iff.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  χ.IsUnramifiedAt v ↔ v ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.key.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {m : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℕ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.TrivOn χ m →
    ∀ (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))),
      (∀ v ∉ S, m v = 0) →
        ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
          (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
              Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x) = 1) →
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x =
              (χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x) *
                ∏ v ∈ S, (χ.finiteComponent v) ((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.key_ram.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x) = 1) →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x =
      (χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x) *
        ∏ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ, (χ.finiteComponent v) ((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.level_dvd.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {z : ℤ},
  (∀ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ, ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ χ.conductorExponent v ∣ z) →
    ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.level_inv.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ⁻¹ = Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.loc.type:
(v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) →

Langlands.HeckeRat.localFactor_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (s : ℂ),
      χ.localFactor w s =
        (1 -
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) *
              ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ^ (-(s + t)))⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.mem_ram.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},

Langlands.HeckeRat.ne_zero_of_val_eq_one.type:

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_chi.type:

  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ), ‖↑(χ ↑x)‖ = Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ x ^ t.re

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_finiteComponent_.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ), Valued.v ↑u = 1 → ‖↑((χ.finiteComponent w) u)‖ = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_infiniteComponen.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (z : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ), ‖↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) z)‖ = ‖↑z‖ ^ t.re

Langlands.HeckeRat.not_good_pr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},

Langlands.HeckeRat.pow_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v ^ χ.conductorExponent v ∣ Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.pr_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v ∣ Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.prime_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {p : ℕ},

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi.type: (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) → (N : ℕ) → Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N → DirichletCharacter ℂ N

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi.congr_simp.type:
∀ (χ χ_1 : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (e_χ : χ = χ_1) (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N),

Langlands.HeckeRat.psiHom.type: (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) → (N : ℕ) → Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N → (ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_apply_int.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑b = ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_intCast_le_iff.type:

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_le_one_of_eq_one.type:

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_neg_one.type:

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_prod_pr_zpow.type:

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_intCast_le_.type:

  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  {a : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v},
  a ≠ 0 → (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.multHaar v) (Metric.sphere 0 ‖a‖) = 1

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.multHaar v) (Metric.sphere 0 1) = 1

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.natCard_re.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  Nat.card (Valued.ResidueField (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)) = Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.norm_local.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  ‖↑(Langlands.localUniformizer K v)‖ = (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.norm_lt_on.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  {x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v}, ‖x‖ < 1 ↔ ‖x‖ ≤ (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.one_lt_q.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), 1 < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.one_sub_in.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), 0 < 1 - (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) → ℝ

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q.congr_si.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v v_1 : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q_pos.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), 0 < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.residue_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (y c : ↥(Valued.integer (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v))),
  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥(Valued.integer (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v))) y =
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥(Valued.integer (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v))) c ↔
    ‖↑y - ↑c‖ < 1

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.setIntegra.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (ψ : AddChar (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ℂ) {r : ℝ},
  (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r, ψ x = 1) →
    ∫ (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) in Metric.closedBall 0 r,
        ψ x ∂Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.haar v =
      ↑((Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.haar v).real (Metric.closedBall 0 r))

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (ψ : AddChar (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ℂ) {r : ℝ}
  {a : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v},
  a ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r →
    ψ a ≠ 1 →
      ∫ (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) in Metric.closedBall 0 r,
          ψ x ∂Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.haar v =
        0

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegr.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [inst_1 : NumberField K] →
      (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) →
        (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v → ℂ) →
          ((IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K),
  χ.IsUnramifiedAt v →
    ∀ (s : ℂ),
      ‖↑((χ.finiteComponent v) (Langlands.localUniformizer K v))‖ < ↑(Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal) ^ s.re →
        Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v
            ((↑(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v)).indicator 1) (χ.finiteComponent v) s =
          χ.localFactor v s

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ),
  (∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ), ‖↑u‖ = 1 → χ u = 1) →
    ∀ (ϖ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ),
      ‖↑ϖ‖ = (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹ →
        ∀ (s : ℂ),
          ‖↑(χ ϖ)‖ < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ s.re →
            Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v ((Metric.closedBall 0 1).indicator 1) χ s =
              (1 - ↑(χ ϖ) * ↑(Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v) ^ (-s))⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_Gammaℝ.type: ∀ {s : ℂ}, s.Gammaℝ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Complex.Gammaℝ s

Langlands.Tate.archChar_neg.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) {z : ℂ}, z ≠ 0 → Langlands.Tate.archChar m (-n) (-t) z = (Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t z)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.archChar_neg_ofReal.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) (r : ℝ), Langlands.Tate.archChar m (-n) t ↑r = Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t ↑r

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    0 < (s + t).re →
      (s + t).re < 1 →
        Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v n t s =
          Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v n *
              (Langlands.Tate.archGamma v (if v.IsReal then n else -n) (-t) (1 - s) /
                Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s) *
            Langlands.Tate.archZeta v n t s

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta_eq_gamma.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    (s + t).re < 1 →
      Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v n t s =
        Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v n *
          ((if v.IsReal then 1 else ↑Real.pi) * Langlands.Tate.archGamma v (if v.IsReal then n else -n) (-t) (1 - s))

Langlands.Tate.archGamma.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archGamma_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → 0 ≤ n) → 0 < (s + t).re → Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s ≠ 0

Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archZeta.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    0 < (s + t).re →
      Langlands.Tate.archZeta v n t s = (if v.IsReal then 1 else ↑Real.pi) * Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s

Langlands.Tate.coe_dualIndexEquiv.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (k : ι → ℤ),

  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (m : ι → ℤ),
  ↑((Langlands.Tate.latticeIndexEquiv L b) m) = (Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) (Langlands.Tate.intPoint m)

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_complexTes.type:
∀ (n : ℤ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n) = fun w =>
    Langlands.Tate.complexRootNumber n * Langlands.Tate.complexTest (-n) w

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_eq_fourier.type: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ), Langlands.Tate.complexFourier f w = 2 * FourierTransform.fourier f (2 * (starRingEnd ℂ) w)

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_gaussConj.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k) = fun w => (-Complex.I) ^ k * Langlands.Tate.gaussHol k w

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_gaussHol.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.gaussHol k) = fun w => (-Complex.I) ^ k * Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k w

Langlands.Tate.complexTest_eq.type:
∀ (n : ℤ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexTest n = if 0 ≤ n then Langlands.Tate.gaussConj n.natAbs else Langlands.Tate.gaussHol n.natAbs

Langlands.Tate.complexTest_mul_archChar.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) (t z : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexTest n z * Langlands.Tate.archChar 2 n t z =
    ↑‖z‖ ^ n.natAbs * Complex.exp (-(↑(2 * Real.pi) * ↑‖z‖ ^ 2)) * ↑‖z‖ ^ (2 * t)

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_complexFourie.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  (s + t).re < 1 →
    Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n)) (-n) (-t) (1 - s) =
      Langlands.Tate.complexRootNumber n * (↑Real.pi * (1 - s - t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ)

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_complexTest.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  0 < (s + t).re →
    Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n) n t s = ↑Real.pi * (s + t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_const_mul.type:
∀ (c : ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (fun z => c * f z) n t s = c * Langlands.Tate.complexZeta f n t s

Langlands.Tate.complex_local_functional_.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  0 < (s + t).re →
    (s + t).re < 1 →
      Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n)) (-n) (-t) (1 - s) =
        Langlands.Tate.complexRootNumber n * ((1 - s - t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ / (s + t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ) *
          Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n) n t s

{V : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] →

        [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] →

            [IsZLattice ℝ L] → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] V

Langlands.Tate.dualMap.congr_simp.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b b_1 : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L),
  b = b_1 → Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b = Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b_1

Langlands.Tate.dualMap_adjoint.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (y : V),
  (Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ↑(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b)) y) = y

Langlands.Tate.dualMap_inner_basis.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (μ : V),

∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}

  Langlands.Tate.torusProj x = Langlands.Tate.torusProj y → ∃ m, x = y + Langlands.Tate.intPoint m

∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_5 : Fintype ι]
  (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L), Module.finrank ℝ V = Fintype.card ι

Langlands.Tate.fourier_add_mul.type:
∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume →
      ∀ (a b v : ℂ),
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x => a * f x + b * g x) v =
          a * FourierTransform.fourier f v + b * FourierTransform.fourier g v

Langlands.Tate.fourier_comp_latticeEquiv.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_7 : BorelSpace V] (f : V → ℂ)
  (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  FourierTransform.fourier (f ∘ ⇑(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b)) k =
    (ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹ • FourierTransform.fourier f ((Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b) k)

Langlands.Tate.fourier_gaussHol.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (v : ℂ),
  FourierTransform.fourier (Langlands.Tate.gaussHol k) v =
    1 / 2 * (-Complex.I / 2) ^ k * v ^ k * Complex.exp ↑(-(Real.pi / 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2))

Langlands.Tate.fourier_gaussian.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] {t : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    ∀ (w : V),
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun v => ↑(Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2))) w =
        ↑(t ^ (↑(Module.finrank ℝ V) / 2))⁻¹ * ↑(Real.exp (-(Real.pi / t) * ‖w‖ ^ 2))

Langlands.Tate.gammaFactor_eq_prod.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ)
  (t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ) (s : ℂ),
  Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s = ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archGamma v (n v) (t v) s

Langlands.Tate.gammaFactor_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → 0 ≤ n v) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (s + t v).re) → Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s ≠ 0

Langlands.Tate.hasDecay_gaussian.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {a : ℝ},
  0 < a → ∀ (N : ℕ), Langlands.Tate.HasDecay (fun v => ↑(Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2))) N

Langlands.Tate.hasDerivAt_fourierGaussCo.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (v u : ℂ),
  HasDerivAt (fun ε => Langlands.Tate.fourierGaussConj k (v + ε • u))
    (1 / 2 * (-Complex.I / 2) ^ k *
      (↑k * (starRingEnd ℂ) v ^ (k - 1) * (starRingEnd ℂ) u * Complex.exp ↑(-(Real.pi / 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) +
        (starRingEnd ℂ) v ^ k * (Complex.exp ↑(-(Real.pi / 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) * ↑(-(Real.pi / 2 * (2 * inner ℝ v u))))))
    0

Langlands.Tate.hasSum_tsum_add_intPoint.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ},
  Continuous f →
    Langlands.Tate.HasSummableTranslates f →
      (Summable fun k => FourierTransform.fourier f (Langlands.Tate.intPoint k)) →
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ d),
          HasSum
            (fun k =>
              FourierTransform.fourier f (Langlands.Tate.intPoint k) *
                Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑(inner ℝ x (Langlands.Tate.intPoint k))))
            (∑' (m : d → ℤ), f (x + Langlands.Tate.intPoint m))

Langlands.Tate.iUnion_tile.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1}, ⋃ m, Langlands.Tate.tile m = Set.univ

Langlands.Tate.inner_dualMap.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (y : V) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  inner ℝ y ((Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b) z) = inner ℝ ((Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b).symm y) z

Langlands.Tate.inner_intPoint.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] (k m : ι → ℤ),

Langlands.Tate.inner_latticeEquiv_dualMa.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)

  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (w z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  inner ℝ ((Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) w) ((Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b) z) = inner ℝ w z

Langlands.Tate.intPoint_add.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} (m n : d → ℤ), Langlands.Tate.intPoint (m + n) = Langlands.Tate.intPoint m + Langlands.Tate.intPoint n

Langlands.Tate.intPoint_apply.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} (m : d → ℤ) (i : d), (Langlands.Tate.intPoint m).ofLp i = ↑(m i)

Langlands.Tate.intPoint_neg.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} (m : d → ℤ), Langlands.Tate.intPoint (-m) = -Langlands.Tate.intPoint m

Langlands.Tate.integrableOn_ball_norm_rp.type:

Langlands.Tate.integrableOn_tile_iff.type:

Langlands.Tate.integrable_complexZeta.type:

Langlands.Tate.integrable_norm_mul_gauss.type: ∀ (k : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖v‖ * ‖Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k v‖) MeasureTheory.volume

Langlands.Tate.integrable_norm_pow_mul_g.type: ∀ (j : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ j * Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi) * ‖z‖ ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume

Langlands.Tate.integrable_norm_rpow_mul_.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

Langlands.Tate.integrable_of_hasSummable.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ},

Langlands.Tate.integrable_realZeta.type:
∀ (f : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},

Langlands.Tate.integral_Ioi_cpow_mul_gau.type:
∀ {c : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    ∀ {w : ℂ},
      0 < w.re →
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, ↑y ^ (w - 1) * Complex.exp (-(↑c * ↑y ^ 2)) = ↑c ^ (-w / 2) * Complex.Gamma (w / 2) / 2

Langlands.Tate.integral_complex_radial.type: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ), ∫ (z : ℂ), g ‖z‖ = 2 * ↑Real.pi * ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, ↑y * g y

Langlands.Tate.integral_real_radial.type: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ), ∫ (x : ℝ), g |x| = 2 * ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, g y

Langlands.Tate.integral_tile_zero_eq_int.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ},
  Continuous f →
    Langlands.Tate.HasSummableTranslates f →
      ∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ),
        Continuous g →
          (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d), ‖g y‖ = 1) →
            (∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d) (m : d → ℤ), g (y + Langlands.Tate.intPoint m) = g y) →
              ∫ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d) in Langlands.Tate.tile 0, g y * Langlands.Tate.periodize f y =
                ∫ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d), g y * f y

Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv.type:
{V : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] →

        [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] →
          [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] →
            [IsZLattice ℝ L] → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃L[ℝ] V

Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv.congr_simp.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b b_1 : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L),
  b = b_1 → Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b = Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b_1

Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv_apply.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  (Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) x = ∑ i, x.ofLp i • ↑(b i)

Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv_intPoint.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}

  (Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) (Langlands.Tate.intPoint m) = ↑(b.equivFun.symm m)

Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv_symm_apply.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (y : V) (i : ι),
  ((Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b).symm y).ofLp i = ((Module.Basis.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ L b).repr y) i

Langlands.Tate.latticeIndexEquiv.type:
{V : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] →
    (L : Submodule ℤ V) → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L → (ι → ℤ) ≃ ↥L

Langlands.Tate.mFourierCoeff_torusPeriod.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ},

      ∀ (k : d → ℤ),
        UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff (Langlands.Tate.torusPeriodize f) k =

Langlands.Tate.mFourier_torusProj.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] (k : d → ℤ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ d),

Langlands.Tate.map_latticeEquiv_volume.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)

  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_7 : BorelSpace V],
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b)) MeasureTheory.volume =
    ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹ • MeasureTheory.volume

Langlands.Tate.measurableSet_tile.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} [Fintype d] (m : d → ℤ), MeasurableSet (Langlands.Tate.tile m)

Langlands.Tate.measurable_archChar.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ), Measurable (Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t)

Langlands.Tate.mem_dualLattice.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) {x : V},

Langlands.Tate.mem_tile_iff.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} {m : d → ℤ} {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d}, y ∈ Langlands.Tate.tile m ↔ ∀ (i : d), ⌈y.ofLp i⌉ = m i + 1

Langlands.Tate.meromorphicOn_gammaFactor.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ)
  (t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ), MeromorphicOn (Langlands.gammaFactor K n t) U

Langlands.Tate.meromorphicOn_of_differen.type: ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ}, (Differentiable ℂ fun s => (f s)⁻¹) → ∀ (U : Set ℂ), MeromorphicOn f U

Langlands.Tate.norm_archChar.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) {z : ℂ}, z ≠ 0 → ‖Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ (↑m * t.re)

Langlands.Tate.norm_archRootNumber.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (n : ℤ), ‖Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v n‖ = 1

Langlands.Tate.norm_complexZeta_integran.type:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s z : ℂ),
  ‖2 * (f z * Langlands.Tate.archChar 2 n t z * ↑‖z‖ ^ (2 * s) / ↑‖z‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ 2 * (‖z‖ ^ (2 * (s + t).re - 2) * ‖f z‖)

Langlands.Tate.norm_gaussConj.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ), ‖Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ k * Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi) * ‖z‖ ^ 2)

Langlands.Tate.norm_le_dualMap.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  ‖z‖ ≤ ‖↑(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b)‖ * ‖(Langlands.Tate.dualMap L b) z‖

Langlands.Tate.norm_le_latticeEquiv.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι),
  ‖z‖ ≤ ‖↑(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b).symm‖ * ‖(Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) z‖

Langlands.Tate.norm_le_of_mem_tile_zero.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d}, y ∈ Langlands.Tate.tile 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ ↑(Fintype.card d)

Langlands.Tate.norm_prod_archRootNumber.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ),
  ‖∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v (n v)‖ = 1

Langlands.Tate.norm_realZeta_integrand_l.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s : ℂ) (x : ℝ),
  ‖f x * Langlands.Tate.archChar 1 n t ↑x * ↑|x| ^ s / ↑|x|‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ ((s + t).re - 1) * ‖f x‖

Langlands.Tate.one_add_pow_mul_exp_le.type:
∀ {a : ℝ},
  0 < a → ∀ (N : ℕ) {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → (1 + r) ^ N * Real.exp (-a * r ^ 2) ≤ ↑N.factorial * Real.exp (1 + 1 / (4 * a))

Langlands.Tate.periodize.type: {d : Type u_1} → (EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.periodize_add_intPoint.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ d) (n : d → ℤ),
  Langlands.Tate.periodize f (x + Langlands.Tate.intPoint n) = Langlands.Tate.periodize f x

Langlands.Tate.periodize_eq_of_torusProj.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → ℂ) {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d},
  Langlands.Tate.torusProj x = Langlands.Tate.torusProj y → Langlands.Tate.periodize f x = Langlands.Tate.periodize f y

Langlands.Tate.preimage_add_tile.type: ∀ {d : Type u_1} (m : d → ℤ), (fun x => x + Langlands.Tate.intPoint m) ⁻¹' Langlands.Tate.tile m = Langlands.Tate.tile 0

Langlands.Tate.prod_archDualZeta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), (s + t v).re < 1) →
      ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
        (∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v (n v)) *
          (↑Real.pi ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K *
            Langlands.gammaFactor K (fun v => if v.IsReal then n v else -n v) (fun v => -t v) (1 - s))

Langlands.Tate.prod_archDualZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (s + t v).re) →
      (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), (s + t v).re < 1) →
        ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
          (∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v (n v)) *
              (Langlands.gammaFactor K (fun v => if v.IsReal then n v else -n v) (fun v => -t v) (1 - s) /
                Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s) *
            ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archZeta v (n v) (t v) s

Langlands.Tate.prod_archZeta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (s + t v).re) →
      ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
        ↑Real.pi ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s

Langlands.Tate.prod_pi_complex.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K],
  (∏ v, if v.IsReal then 1 else ↑Real.pi) = ↑Real.pi ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K

Langlands.Tate.realFourier_eq_fourier.type: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ), Langlands.Tate.realFourier f = FourierTransform.fourier f

Langlands.Tate.realFourier_realTest.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    Langlands.Tate.realFourier (Langlands.Tate.realTest a) = fun y =>
      Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * Langlands.Tate.realTest a y

Langlands.Tate.realTest_mul_archChar.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ (t : ℂ) (x : ℝ),
      Langlands.Tate.realTest a x * Langlands.Tate.archChar 1 a t ↑x =
        ↑|x| ^ a.toNat * Complex.exp (-(↑Real.pi * ↑|x| ^ 2)) * ↑|x| ^ t

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_const_mul.type:
∀ (c : ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.realZeta (fun x => c * f x) n t s = c * Langlands.Tate.realZeta f n t s

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_realFourier_real.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ},
      (s + t).re < 1 →
        Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realFourier (Langlands.Tate.realTest a)) a (-t) (1 - s) =
          Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * (1 - s - t + ↑a).Gammaℝ

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_realTest.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ}, 0 < (s + t).re → Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realTest a) a t s = (s + t + ↑a).Gammaℝ

Langlands.Tate.real_local_functional_equ.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ},
      0 < (s + t).re →
        (s + t).re < 1 →
          Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realFourier (Langlands.Tate.realTest a)) a (-t) (1 - s) =
            Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * ((1 - s - t + ↑a).Gammaℝ / (s + t + ↑a).Gammaℝ) *
              Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realTest a) a t s

Langlands.Tate.repr_latticeEquiv.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_4 : IsZLattice ℝ L] {ι : Type u_2}
  [inst_5 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι),
  ((Module.Basis.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ L b).repr ((Langlands.Tate.latticeEquiv L b) x)) i = x.ofLp i

Langlands.Tate.setIntegral_tile.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ d → E) (m : d → ℤ),
  ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ d) in Langlands.Tate.tile m, g z =
    ∫ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ d) in Langlands.Tate.tile 0, g (y + Langlands.Tate.intPoint m)

Langlands.Tate.summable_dualLattice_of_h.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {f : V → ℂ} {N : ℕ},
